newsitem.title: USA: Checkers reaches debt restructuring pact.
newsitem.headline: Checkers reaches debt restructuring pact.

text.p: Checkers Drive-In Restaurants Inc said Tuesday it has reached an agreement in principal on the restructuring of debt with a new lending group.
The deal allows for a one-year extension of its credit facility, until July 31, 1999, the company said.
The principal repayment schedule has been greatly reduced during the term, the company said. It allows for no principal payments scheduled through the first reporting period of 1997.
In reporting periods two through eight of 1997, the company is scheduled to make principal reduction payments of $200,000 per period.
Those payments increase to $275,000 in reporting periods nine through 13 in 1997, and to $350,000 thereafter, the company said.
Checkers Drive-In said it has agreed to a fixed interest rate of 13.75 percent.
The agreement also calls for a restructuring fee of $4 million, which is payable at maturity and can be converted into common stock at the option of the company and/or the fund group, Checkers said.
